summary: Strengthen your oil and gas project teams with our specialized training in team building and conflict resolution. Drive success through effective collaboration
lede: Team building and conflict resolution for oil and gas projects helps multidisciplinary teams coordinate across contractor and technical interfaces. It is for project managers, engineers, construction or commissioning leads, and HSSE or commercial coordinators who need to keep delivery teams aligned. Participants practice mapping roles and contractor interfaces, applying negotiation and de-escalation techniques, and setting issue escalation pathways with team charters, RACI matrices, and conflict logs.
audienceIntro: This course is built for you if you work across project delivery, contractor management, safety coordination, or commercial interfaces in oil and gas and need practical ways to keep teams aligned when pressure rises.
prerequisites: You need a laptop for working on templates and case exercises, plus basic familiarity with oil and gas project roles, contractor interfaces, and common delivery documents. Please bring one real or representative project issue, such as a recurring team conflict, interface dispute, or communication breakdown, so you can complete the practical exercises.
